message:
Hey friends! I just came across a super helpful resource about preparing for power outages, and I couldn't resist sharing it. As someone who may or may not have a dedicated emergency supplies closet (okay, I do!), I find it reassuring to have a plan in place for when the lights go out. 

This guide from the Red Cross covers everything from stocking up on essentials to keeping your family safe and comfortable during a blackout. It's all about being gloriously over-prepared and ready for anything that comes our way! 

What’s your favorite tip for staying cozy during a power outage? I'd love to hear your tricks! 🌟
